items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: John McNeely, Charles Dimes, myself, Edward Johnson, we were all good friends.

ctx.x: Was that about why you bought the Zoot Suit?

Well, yes, because it was a style at the time. John McNeely, Charles Dimes, myself, Edward Johnson, we were all good friends. And we all would meet down on Rampart Street and we'd party at the Pelican or sometime we went to the Tick Tock. We used to go to the, see, then we'd go to the Palace Theater where all the big bands would come. And we had Savannah Churchill, where Red Fox, where, let's see who all would come down there. I'm just trying to think of one of them. Buddy Johnson played down there. Favorite…
So, what was, when you talked about Rampart Street, was that like the happening?
